$description: Folio DS theme-independent tokens. v0.3.0 puts everything on an 8pt grid: sizes are multiples of 4, line-heights, spacing and control heights are multiples of 8. Radius stays 0. Elevation is expressed by surface level, never by shadow.

family-sans.$description: Structural face: h2/h3, nav, buttons, chips, and every DS component. Since v0.4.0 this is the mono — the UI speaks in one voice.

family-body.$description: Reading face. Paragraphs and descriptions only — never UI, never headings.

family-display.$description: Pixel display face. Hero (h1) and the boot loader only — never body copy, never below 32px.

text.$description: Six sizes. Everything else — mono, uppercase, weight — is a treatment applied on top of one of these, not a size of its own.

hero.$description: 40px on mobile, 64px on desktop. Fluid between; on-grid at both design breakpoints.

subtitle.$description: 20px. Subtitles, intro and lead copy, accordion titles.

body.$description: 16px. Body copy, buttons, nav, stat values.

small.$description: 12px. Captions, chips, tags, mono labels, badges. The floor of the system.

leading.$description: Line-heights in rem so they land on the 8px grid. Display sizes use 1 and are on-grid because their sizes are.

space.$description: Named by pixel value so the grid is legible in code and in Figma. 4 is the only half-step, reserved for inner component padding.

4.$description: Half-step. Inner padding of tags and badges only.

control.$description: Fixed heights for interactive elements. Components set these with box-sizing: border-box so borders never push them off-grid.

none.$description: The system's only radius — sharp corners are part of the identity

full.$description: Circular. Status dots and the nav mark only.

notch.$description: Outer step of the pixel-corner clip-path on primary CTAs

notch-inner.$description: Inner step of the pixel-corner clip-path

elevation.$description: Three surface levels and no shadow. Raising an element means moving it up one level and, if it floats, giving it a 1px border.

1.$description: Hover states, raised panels, sticky bars.

2.$description: Cards, popovers, toasts, the lightbox chrome.
